theOpenQuestionForRoger.question: Does visualDefects count emphasis that renders flat?
theOpenQuestionForRoger.whyItIsNotMine: Two definitions are in use in this repository and both are defensible. Under one, these two families are clean. Under the other, they and every family shipping markdown emphasis carry a nonzero counter, and F8 refuses completion on a nonzero counter.
theOpenQuestionForRoger.itsScope: Not Indiana's alone. Any family whose guidance renders emphasis flat is in the same position; nobody has counted them.
theOpenQuestionForRoger.andThePromotionIsReversible: If the conservative reading is the right one, these two are withdrawn. Nothing is destroyed by promoting them now and nothing is hidden by it.
